summary.text: Tim Sharman is an independent candidate on the general-election ballot for Virginia's 8th District. Ballotpedia lists no campaign profile or key messages for him; FEC filings show $25,000 in receipts as of June 30, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sharman, 62, told Agence France-Presse that he does not feel he belongs in either the Democratic or Republican party and that he comes with a business background.
He said he spent $40,000 to gather the 1,000 verified signatures needed to reach the ballot and runs a one-person campaign with help from friends.
